mandatoryCriteria: Restore destination conflict handling: If original column was deleted while card was trashed, restore requires explicit toColumnId
Missing destination rejection: Attempting to restore without toColumnId when original column is missing returns 400 or 409 DESTINATION_MISSING with details
Active column verification: Provided toColumnId must be an active column on the same board
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Destination column conflict resolution on restore.
